prompt:
Which theme to do?
All good things must come to an end; remember, they do, because each has their own life, and no one belongs to anyone. But it was a time spent together, a shared memory. Some will forget quickly, but that doesn't matter; whoever remembers keeps it. This beauty—some might discard it, which is normal, but whoever holds it in their heart, that beauty still belongs to them.

Which aspect ratio?
Horizontal 16:9

post.originalText:
一段话，两个版本。opus5.5！完成！

我给他的话是：

做哪个主题？
天下没有不散的宴席，记着，没有，因为各自都有各自的生活，谁也不是谁的谁，但是呢就是一段共同度过的岁月，就是共同的记忆，但有的人就会很快忘掉，这不重要，谁记着属于谁，就这一份美好，有人会把他抛弃，这很正常，但是谁把它记在心里，这份美好依旧属于谁.

用什么画幅？

横屏 16:9

买一个 5✖️的 claude ，选主题，模型选择 opus5.5 选择强度：超高。
然后就可以了。
